purpose: Define the generic TTL and archive lifecycle for provenance sidecar/map records so active registry stays small, Hot Path stays compact, and historical traceability is preserved without bloat.
scope_rule: Generic OS-level lifecycle contract. No runtime patch, DB schema change, product-specific code, or new engine in this phase.
core_invariants: Active registry/map keeps active or pending provenance only where practical.
Completed, expired, rejected, or canonicalized provenance must leave the active registry lifecycle and move to archive/evidence sidecar reference.
Hot Path never scans archive or full sidecar history.
Heavy Path may lookup archived provenance by correlation_id only within budget.
Archive movement must preserve lineage, raw/source hash references and version history.

ttl_classes.use_case: short-lived staging/context records with low audit value
items waiting for Heavy Path, review, provenance completion or quarantine decision
items linked to evidence, audit, security, anomaly, opportunity or future replay
future training camp or evaluation records
future internal affairs or runtime audit records

state_transition_rules.condition: sidecar confirmed and staging/context item ready
ttl expired, missing provenance, conflict, or partial write unresolved
validated as context by allowed validation process
active use complete or canonical/evidence reference produced
quarantine resolved, expired, rejected, or retained for audit
archive_ref, hashes, lifecycle state and version lineage confirmed
low value stale item exceeds ttl and no evidence/review value remains
poisoned, malformed, conflicting, or forbidden-field record confirmed

budget_rules.hot_path_budget: Hot Path reads compact state only; no sidecar or archive lookup.
budget_rules.heavy_path_budget: Heavy Path may lookup active or archived sidecar by correlation_id within bounded cost.
budget_rules.archive_budget: Archive lifecycle may be async/batched and must not block Hot Path.
budget_rules.failure_policy: If lifecycle movement fails, item remains non-ready or quarantine/review-only; never silently becomes ready.

real_test_note_for_later.user_request: When the News section is completed, perform a real test.
real_test_note_for_later.safe_interpretation: After NOAPI contract + fixture + validator + dryrun stages pass and runtime patch is explicitly approved, run a bounded real/shadow/read-only News validation test.
